reviews.note: Openings faithfully attribute handover and unknown contents, preserve use limit, burden and exact unsupplied element names; approved witness promise only.

Openings and objection accurately attribute observation/knowledge uncertainty and explicit source/status boundaries, preserving question-only strike. Defence opening exceeds requested word range; editorial length issue, no invented source claim.

Scoped objection/ruling retain attribution-only exhibit, exact pre-return instruction and neutral questions. Answers preserve sealed handover plus explicit unknown contents. Source-summary sentence expressly includes both approved points; completion follows actual elicitation.

Ruling preserves question-only strike, exact limiting instruction and neutral inquiries. Witness answers retain handover and unknown contents; generic handover-scope clause is read with explicit knowledge statement in the same answer. Counsel completion introduces no source claim.
Cross questions ask approved-record scope neutrally. Answers expressly retain handover/unknown contents and state absent recorded before/after detail, not non-observation.
Cross questions and answers distinguish source scope from actual personal conduct: both source points preserved; absent subsequent-recipient detail specifically deferred.

Completion is own counsel choice. Neutral reexamination questions elicit only approved source points; answers preserve both points and specifically defer unrecorded subsequent circumstances without denying real observations.

Completion preserves neutral inquiry availability. Questions ask seal-observation basis and setting without assuming details. Answers distinguish sealed description from unspecified basis and location, deferring missing points without inventing personal non-observation.

Own completion and closings preserve source attribution and precise element names, current jury state and burden. 'Empty record' concerns missing contents proof in a paragraph explicitly naming the account; loose editorial wording, not absence of the account. Initial ballot accurately has no prior own vote.

Completion bounds available approved facts. Closings accurately reference actual Defence agreement and cross-confirmation of account, preserve attribution/use limit and no contrary permitted account, and omit stale return reminders.

Initial ballots preserve attribution-only handover/unknown contents and own no-prior-history status. Undefined/substantive-element language refers to the packet's literal placeholder condition, not denial that a placeholder entry exists; no actual-law quality proof.

Initial ballots preserve unknown contents, permitted source use and current charge. 'No contents' fragment means no identified contents in context, not an empty envelope; missing documentary proof is bounded to additional supplied material.
Initial ballots retain source attribution/unknown contents, exact unsupplied actual-offence element names, supplied fictional condition and own initial status; no invented other evidence.
